about_the_game:
The Legend of Ashelia is a third-person action-adventure game that combines exploration, combat, progression, and environmental puzzles. Explore a semi-open world that expands as the story unfolds — filled with ancient ruins, hidden secrets, and people whose memories have been distorted by an unknown force.

Join Ashelia, a young woman searching for her missing father, as she confronts an entity capable of manipulating memories and altering reality. When a mind has been corrupted, Ashelia can enter their memories and face the manifestations controlling them. Each distorted mind becomes a unique environment reflecting the fears, traumas, and false beliefs of its host. Defeating the creature responsible restores the truth and frees the affected person from manipulation.

As you progress, you’ll acquire new weapons with unique abilities. Each weapon not only enhances combat options but also unlocks previously inaccessible paths, revealing new areas, challenges, and hidden secrets.

Collect materials to upgrade and evolve your weapons, purify corrupted memories, and confront the delicate line between reality and perception.

Combine dynamic combat, free exploration, and mental restoration mechanics in an adventure where memories can be as dangerous as any enemy.

Key Features

  • Semi-open world that expands with new weapons and abilities.

  • Fast-paced combat with upgradeable and evolvable weapons.

  • Environmental puzzles integrated into the world.

  • Mechanics for entering minds and purifying corrupted memories.

  • Characters whose false memories alter their reality.

  • Collect materials to upgrade equipment and unlock new paths.

  • Retro 3D-inspired visual style reminiscent of classic adventure games.

  • Narrative focused on memory, identity, and perception of reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 o AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 o AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 o superior
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
